about: Moments on one time window across lanes, such as deploys and incidents per service. Moments of a lane closer than minGap of the window share a marker that counts them, and every lane shares the window, so the lanes compare.

burst.about: Seven alerts within two minutes share one marker in the color of its loudest moment. defaultIndex opens the tooltip at the marker: the heading names the lane and the range, and the rows list five alerts and then moreLabel's count of the rest.
burst.caption: Seven alerts in two minutes followed the deploy at 13:52 UTC.
burst.label: Changes and alerts during the incident
burst.title: Clusters

deploys.about: Deploys and incidents of four services over one day, a lane per service in the order lanes lists them. A moment without a lane goes into the lane otherLabel names. The time axis writes five evenly spaced times in 24-hour UTC.
deploys.caption: The api raised three alerts between 14:03 and 14:09 UTC and rolled back at 16:20.
deploys.label: Deploys and incidents on 28 September
deploys.title: Lanes

narrow.about: The day's deploys in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone. Each lane keeps its name, and the time axis leaves out a time that would meet another.
narrow.title: Narrow room

quiet.about: A timeline without a moment inside its window renders the empty state in the plot's place.
quiet.caption: Deploys and incidents today.
quiet.label: Deploys and incidents today
quiet.title: Empty

releases.about: One lane of releases over a year. A chart of one lane renders no lane axis, and the tooltip heads a marker with its date alone. ticks sets three dates on the time axis, and labelOptions writes them in the medium date style.
releases.caption: Two of the year's nine releases needed a patch within three days.
releases.label: Releases from October 2025 to September 2026
releases.title: One lane

replay.about: animate grows each marker from its centre when the chart mounts, and Replay mounts the chart again. Under reduced motion recharts renders the markers at once.
replay.caption: The web deployed three times, and the api rolled back after its alerts.
replay.label: Deploys on 28 September
replay.title: Animation

select.about: onSelect receives a marker's moments on a press, or on Enter or Space while the arrow keys walk the markers. The line under the chart lists the moments of the marker selected last.
select.caption: Press a marker to list its moments.
select.label: Deploys and incidents of the api and the database
select.title: Selection

title: Timeline chart
